programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: The head of a rich family dies and in his will leaves his fortune to his daughter. His son is enraged and uses a rubbish collector who looks the same as his sister to steal the fortune. The Uncle's son also wants a piece of the fortune and coerces a small time thief into stealing the will for his wild scheme.

programme.title: Kung Fu Jungle
programme.desc: Kung Fu Jungle follows a martial arts instructor who is imprisoned after a fatal accident. When a serial killer begins targeting martial arts masters, he offers his help to the police in exchange for freedom. A deadly game of skill and survival unfolds as he confronts the killer using his mastery of kung fu.

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: A poor couple, Shui and Ti, try to make a life on their own. And through both of their hard work, Shui becomes a marketing executive, then his attitude begins to change.

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Never Leave

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: An actor tries to convince a lady to play Samantha in an adaptation of the classic TV series, but unbeknownst to him, she really is a witch!

programme.title: Song Of The Assassins
programme.desc: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family's massacre years ago. While taking on the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy.

programme.title: Hail The Judge
programme.desc: A judge tries to save a female innocent who's wrongly being accused for murder.

programme.title: Fist Of Legend
programme.desc: When Chen Zhen studies in Japan, he finds several Chinese students missing and accidentally uncovers the Black Dragon Society's conspiracy.

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its “Cop Shop Babes” as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat – can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission. But his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: Unmatchable Match
programme.desc: Ruthless gangster Guts pulls off a heist of diamonds, then enlists the aid of longtime triad member, Fei, to arrange a buyer for them. But when Guts double crosses the buyer, Fei ends up with the diamonds, wanted by both the cops and Guts.

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy about a murdered cop returning from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie (Chow) into avenging his death.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon 2
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau’s Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city’s casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li Tsu-liang is newly widowed and leading an impoverished life with two young sons. He attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing track, but is subsequently entangled with the loan sharks.

programme.title: Let The Bullets Fly
programme.desc: In 1920s China, a bandit arrives in a remote provincial town posing as its new mayor, where he faces off against a tyrannical local nobleman.

programme.title: Challenge Of The Gamesters
programme.desc: Wong Jing created the gambling film genre almost singlehandedly, and in one of his earliest blockbusters, Shih Hsien leads a stellar cast in a tale of spies, tycoons and beautiful babes.

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: JJ/Shu Qi and PI Lam (Dong jing gong lüe (2000)) steal 2 stolen USD100 plates in HK. Lam loses them - no US reward. Lam and his 3 cute angels try to get them again in Seoul as does JJ. Lots of fighting.

programme.title: Girl With The Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: Girl With The Diamond Slipper

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: A man received a haunted mail predicting his death. A man mourns the death of his beloved wife. Three brothers clashes over dinner.

programme.title: Young Heroes Of Chaotic Times
programme.desc: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

programme.title: Get In The Dark
programme.desc: Miss Qiao had died in vain and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll. Miss Qiao's spirit is revived to take revenge and a series of horrible events begins to happen.

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Small-time conman and mechanic Lolanto finds himself in trouble when he cheats gangster Yu Yan Tat out of his high-end sports car on a three-day loan, where new sparkplugs would have sufficed.

programme.title: Nezha
programme.desc: A former top team racing driver wants to prove himself in a race but accidentally hurts his teammate Lily. When an inexperienced virtual car racing champion joins the team, can they team up to regain team's glory?

programme.title: The Case Of Disappearances
programme.desc: When Qing Cheng was a teenager, he was attacked by an unknown mutant monster and lost his family and memory. He was regarded by the villagers as an ominous person who would bring disaster.

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Long Wei has post-traumatic stress disorder after his wife's death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, he becomes the firm's VR fighter.

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: A washed-up writer forms an unlikely friendship with a teenager from Long Island.

programme.title: Gangster, The Cop, The Devil
programme.desc: Detective Lin sets up a special unit to arrest the motorbike robber and the crime syndicate behind the thefts in Foshan. His pregnant wife is hit by a motorbike robber, leading him to uncover their revenge plan.

programme.title: Hong Kong, Hong Kong
programme.desc: A story of the illegal immigrant experience of people from the mainland of China who have made it to Hong Kong for a better life.
